title: Filters and form validation
summary: Format and sort data with filters, and validate a form with ng-required, $valid and ng-disabled.

quiz.explain: A filter transforms a value for display. The pipe `|` sends `city` into the `uppercase` filter. The original scope value stays `pune`.

quiz.q: Which expression sorts `items` by price from lowest to highest in an `ng-repeat`?
quiz.explain: `orderBy` is the built-in sorting filter. Put a minus sign before the name, `'-price'`, to reverse the order.

quiz.q: Complete the button so it is disabled while the form named `regForm` is invalid.
quiz.explain: `ng-disabled` sets the real `disabled` attribute when its expression is true.

quiz.q: A form is named `regForm` and has a required field that is empty. What is `regForm.$valid`?
quiz.explain: AngularJS tracks every field. If any field breaks a rule, the whole form has `$valid` false and `$invalid` true.

quiz.q: The form should be named so the button can check it, but `regForm` is never defined. Click the faulty line.
quiz.explain: AngularJS publishes the form on the scope using the form's `name` attribute. Write `<form name="regForm">`.

exercise.task:
Complete `index.html`.

- Show each product name in capitals with the `uppercase` filter.
- Show each price with the `currency` filter.
- Sort the `ng-repeat` by `price` with `orderBy`.
- Make the email input required.
- Disable the button while the form is invalid, using the form's `$invalid` or `$valid`.
hints: Filters go inside the braces after a pipe. orderBy goes at the end of the ng-repeat expression. The form already has the name regForm.
{{ item.name | uppercase }}, {{ item.price | currency }}, item in items | orderBy:'price'. For validation, use required (or ng-required) on the input and ng-disabled on the button.
• {{ item.name | uppercase }} {{ item.price | currency }}

checks.name: The name uses the uppercase filter
The price uses the currency filter
The list is sorted with orderBy on price
checks.hint: Change the ng-repeat to: item in items | orderBy:'price'.

checks.name: The email input is required
checks.hint: Add required or ng-required="true" to the email input.

checks.name: The button is disabled while the form is invalid
